title: NL-hardness of the raw path language
statement: Let $L$ be a language of binary strings in nondeterministic logarithmic space. Then $L$ has a logspace many-one reduction to the raw path language: there is a logspace-computable map sending a string $x$ to a string in the raw path language exactly when $x\in L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of binary strings
